column4: AI-specific research reviewer for fabrication, hidden assumptions, edge cases, and confidence calibration.
Research code reviewer focused on bugs, correctness, and material quality issues.
Document-to-code consistency reviewer for empirical claims and narrative alignment.
Number verification reviewer that traces document claims back to code and data.
EIG writing and style reviewer for prose, citations, figures, and presentation consistency.
EIG visualization and style specialist for producing, styling, and reviewing charts, tables, and Datawrapper outputs.
EIG writing specialist for drafting, revising, and tightening policy or research prose.
Repository maintenance specialist for drift checks, freshness checks, and hygiene audits.
Econometrics and methodology reviewer for research design, assumptions, and inference risks.
Top-level coordinator that routes work across review, style, and maintenance specialists.

Economics literature scout that maps key researchers, harvests and snowballs the literature on a question, and produces a tiered annotated bibliography persisted to the repository catalog. Use upstream of analysis.

Acquires authoritative data dictionaries pinned to the vintage in use and converts the relevant variables into structured registry entries and Markdown docs. Use upstream of analysis to document a project's data sources.
